title: Head comercial
description:
Se você é do tipo que gosta de construir resultados concretos, ter autonomia e assumir a frente do crescimento, essa é a função onde o seu trabalho vai ter impacto real. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um head — será a pessoa responsável por expandir nossa carteira de imóveis, encantar proprietários e transformar leads em clientes fiéis.

Nossa cultura e o que buscamos

A Catete Apartments é uma das empresas líderes em administração de imóveis de temporada no Rio de Janeiro, com mais de 80 propriedades e mais de 1 milhão de visualizações mensais nas redes sociais. Crescemos 5x nos últimos 12 meses e queremos continuar expandindo com qualidade.

Por isso, é fundamental que a pessoa nesse cargo incorpore nossos valores — Encantar, Entregar, Resolver e Colaborar. Como Head Comercial, você representa a Catete Apartments para todos os nossos clientes e, indiretamente, para o crescimento de toda a nossa operação e reputação. Você terá a oportunidade (e a responsabilidade) de criar confiança desde o primeiro contato e garantir que cada proprietário veja valor no nosso trabalho logo nos primeiros meses.

Seus principais desafios:

  • Definir e executar a estratégia comercial da empresa.
  • Orquestrar o calendário de conteúdos em @amandarestom e @cateteapartments, que somam quase 2 milhões de visualizações mensais.
  • Conduzir reuniões consultivas e apresentar propostas de valor que encantem e convertam.
  • Mapear oportunidades de mercado e criar novas linhas de receita.
  • Acompanhar indicadores (CAC, LTV, conversão, churn etc.).
  • Liderar, treinar e expandir a equipe comercial.
  • Reportar resultados diretamente para a diretoria/CEO.

Expectativas para os primeiros 6 meses

  • Atingir a meta de 5 novos apartamentos/mês, mantendo a qualidade do ICP.
  • Reduzir o tempo médio de onboarding para menos de 7 dias.
  • Implementar rituais de acompanhamento com clientes nos primeiros 90 dias.
  • Garantir que os novos apartamentos recebam avaliações iniciais 5 estrelas, com meta de zero avaliações de 3 estrelas ou menos nos primeiros meses de operação.

O que oferecemos

  • Salário mensal de R$5.000,00 a R$7.000,00.
  • Bônus semestral por desempenho.
  • Trabalho híbrido.
  • Treinamento e reporte direto às sócias da empresa.
  • Crescimento rápido e possibilidade real de se tornar sócio(a).
  • Cultura inovadora, com abertura para implementar ideias e processos.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Economia, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência prévia em liderança comercial, gestão de processos ou coordenação de equipes.
  • Facilidade com ferramentas digitais e CRMs.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e atenção a detalhes.
  • Capacidade de adaptação a mudanças e de autogestão.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
Local: Remoto

Contrato: PJ (tempo integral)

Nível: Executivo

Reporta-se a: CEO

Sobre a vaga

Procuramos um(a) COO para estruturar e conduzir o "sistema operacional" da empresa, transformar estratégia em execução, eliminar falhas de follow-up entre solicitações e entregas e garantir cadência, métricas e accountability em todas as áreas.

O(a) COO participará das dailys com os gestores de cada área, atuará como elo de comunicação entre times e stakeholders e apresentará mensalmente (em inglês) relatórios executivos consolidados.

Destaques : direito a assistente executivo(a) dedicado(a) e bônus por performance.

Responsabilidades

  • Gestão das operações diárias, garantindo eficiência e alinhamento com a estratégia definida pelo CEO e pelo Conselho.
  • Implementar a visão estratégica em planos de execução operacional com donos, prazos e critérios claros.
  • Supervisionar áreas-chave: desenvolvimento web, desenvolvimento de software, marketing, customer success e suporte.
  • Participar das dailys com os gestores; registrar decisões, prazos, riscos e encaminhamentos.
  • Relatórios operacionais: diários (EOD) com status por área, itens concluídos, tarefa atual + ETA, próximas 3 tarefas (início/fim) e gargalos; semanais e mensais com consolidação de KPIs, riscos, decisões e plano de ação.
  • Mensais em inglês: apresentações executivas a stakeholders com dados consolidados de todos os setores.
  • Apoiar o CFO com dados operacionais para relatórios financeiros e previsões.
  • Reuniões em inglês para contratação de serviços/fornecedores; reuniões com parceiros B2B para coletar feedback e operacionalizar demandas.
  • Gestão de contratações de colaboradores (pipeline, aprovação, integração) e gestão de desempenho (elevar produtividade; desligar quem não performa).
  • Aprimorar processos visando redução de custos, aumento de produtividade e padronização.
  • Gerenciar KPIs (On-time Delivery, Lead Time, Throughput, WIP, Blocker Aging, SLA stage/prod, MTTR, CSAT/NPS), propor ajustes e remover bloqueios.
  • Conformidade e qualidade nos processos; gestão de riscos e planos de contingência.
  • Fomentar inovação em processos, sistemas e práticas de gestão.
  • Assegurar comunicação clara entre áreas e níveis da empresa.
  • Disciplina de ferramentas: Jira (backlog, prazos, status, dashboards) e Confluence (documentação, atas, decisões) como fontes únicas de verdade.

Requisitos

  • 3+ anos como COO (ou função executiva equivalente).
  • 5+ anos de experiência comprovada em Operações.
  • 5+ anos de experiência comprovada em tecnologia e experiência prévia em empresa de software.
  • Conhecimento sólido sobre jogos online (conceitos de latência/lag, jitter, perda de pacotes, impacto na operação e suporte).
  • Domínio prático de Jira e Confluence.
  • Inglês fluente (falado e escrito): dailys, relatórios e apresentações mensais a stakeholders; calls com fornecedores e parceiros.
  • Liderança hands-on, orientação a dados, habilidade de priorizar, cobrar resultados e resolver bloqueios rapidamente.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência profissional no mercado de games.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks de gestão (OKRs, RACI, SLAs).
  • Certificações relevantes (Lean/Six Sigma, PMP, Agile/SAFe).

Sucesso nos 90 dias

  • Dailys com gestores estabelecidas e atas no Confluence.
  • Relatórios diários, semanais e mensais publicados com consistência.
  • Apresentações mensais em inglês bem-sucedidas com stakeholders, com dados consolidados de todos os setores, decisões registradas no Confluence e plano de ação com owners e ETAs.
  • Dashboard no Jira confiável (prazos, status stage/prod, SLAs).
  • Redução visível de atrasos, itens sem dono e falhas de follow-up.

Ambiente & benefícios

  • Trabalho 100% remoto, autonomia e alto impacto.
  • Assistente executivo(a) dedicado(a).
  • Remuneração compatível com mercado + bônus por performance.
  • Cultura de disciplina, colaboração e melhoria contínua.

First Month

  • Familiarize yourself with the extensive support materials available to successfully support our clients and talent.
  • Learn the key internal and external stakeholders and how clients can best be served by the different Toptal teams during their lifecycle.
  • Have a solid understanding of the Toptal platform as it relates to clients and the most frequent request processes.
  • Effectively and independently resolve client issues.
  • Gain a comprehensive working knowledge of the client experience from start to finish.

First Three Months

  • Confidently onboard to our support organization, tools, and workflows.
  • Build strong working relationships with the Director and Support Managers.
  • Be comfortable extracting data from Tableau, SQL, and Zendesk to produce accurate weekly and ad-hoc reports.

First Six Months

  • Be recognized as the “go-to” person for data extraction, workflow troubleshooting, and Zendesk admin needs.

  • Start to contribute ideas for larger process or system enhancements.

First Year

  • Be fully confident operating as the operational backbone of the support organisation while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Anticipate leadership needs by proactively surfacing insights, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Lead small-to-medium operational projects (queue redesign, automation rollouts, feature pilots).
  • Establish clear reporting and automation processes that run smoothly without micromanagement.
  • Be trusted as both a subject matter expert in tools and a partner in shaping how support operates at scale.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 3+ years of experience in operations roles.
  • Intermediate SQL proficiency is required. You should be comfortable writing queries to extract and transform data.
  • Strong proficiency with G Suite tools, especially tools for analysis and reporting.
  • Zendesk admin experience, including managing queues, triggers, macros, and dashboard setup, is a strong advantage.
  • Comfortable extracting data from Tableau.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools, such as Zapier and Slack workflows.
  • Collaborative. Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong, customer-centric relationships, both internally and externally.
  • Team-oriented. Cooperative and promotes an environment of continuous improvement.
  • Problem solver. Must be capable of uncovering issues and resolving them quickly and effectively.
  • Time management. Must be able to work independently and manage multiple priorities without constant supervision.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

title: Senior Backend & Cloud Infra. Engineer - Python+AWS (LATAM)
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Python Cloud Engineer (LATAM) role at Lateral Group

About The Company

Lateral stands for technology excellence. We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality. Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

  • We Have A Bias For Action & Results. We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results speak for themselves.
  • We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality - Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.
  • We Care Deeply - We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.
  • Every detail matters - Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.
  • We Do Things Right - Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching.
  • We Keep Improving - Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.
  • We’re Obsessed With Agility - We chase momentum by adapting processes to fit problems, not the other way around.
  • We Take Ownership - Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas and the trust to execute.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Cloud Python Engineer at Lateral you will:

  • Build and maintain reliable, scalable backend systems with a focus on Python, AWS, and cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Design and implement APIs and batch processing jobs that serve real-world products.
  • Help architect and evolve cloud infrastructure (primarily on AWS) for availability, observability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Write clean, well-tested code that’s easy to understand, easy to debug, and built to last.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including ML and product to ship high-impact features and systems.
  • Automate away repetitive tasks and eliminate bottlenecks with thoughtful scripting and service design.
  • Support infrastructure-as-code efforts and deployment pipelines (Terraform, CDK, etc.).
  • Work closely with senior engineers to make thoughtful trade-offs around performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
  • Own features from spec to production, with the autonomy and support to do great work.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for backend engineers who love building clean, reliable systems and enjoy solving real problems with real code. You’ll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in backend engineering
  • Strong proficiency in Python for building APIs, services, or batch processing jobs
  • Solid experience with AWS services (e.g. ECS, S3, RDS, SQS, Lambda, etc.)
  • Proficiency in SQL Databases (Postgres)
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK)
  • Strong grasp of software design principles, API development and batch job design and data processing in Python
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices
  • Comfort owning systems end-to-end: from design to deployment to monitoring
  • A quality mindset - you value clean code, good documentation, and thoughtful testing
  • Clear communication, async collaboration skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving

Bonus points for

  • Experience with DICOM specific frameworks (PyDICOM, SimpleITK, OsiriX, OHIF, Orthanc)
  • Prior work in performance-sensitive or highly reliable systems
  • Contributions to internal tooling, observability, or deployment automation
  • Familiarity with security best practices for cloud and backend services
  • Experience working with sensitive data, such as PII or PHI, in a regulated industry (e.g., healthcare, finance)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.
  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive. We’re a remote-first company, but you’re welcome to drop in if you’re near an office.
  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft and each other.
  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility.
  • A Culture of Excellence: High-quality work delivered sustainably with no burnout or crunch.
  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong with fresh challenges on every project.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. Skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer a well-defined hierarchy and fixed roles.
  • Distributed work and async collaboration aren’t your thing.
  • Feedback doesn’t excite you; we value continuous improvement and may provide nitpicky feedback.
  • Change makes you uncomfortable; priorities shift as we scale and mature.

However, if this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is
  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible
  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Step 1: Express Your Interest

If this sounds like your kind of team and you’re ready to bring your craft to Lateral, we want to hear from you. Please send us:

  • Your resume
  • A short note about what excites you about this role
  • Links to your work: GitHub/Code snippets, portfolio, architecture/design docs, blog posts, or anything that shows how you think and build

Please don’t include anything sensitive or proprietary. If you’re sharing team projects, let us know what your specific contributions were. We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral's values.

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.
  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.
  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics
  • Motivators and demotivators.
  • Your life outside coding.

Step 3: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you'd encounter in the position.
  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Step 4: Client interviews

Purpose: Evaluate collaboration, communication, and consultation with external stakeholders.

  • Discussion around business and technical challenges from the client’s perspective.
  • Explain your approach, gather requirements, ask clarifying questions, and articulate tradeoffs.
  • Evaluation of how clearly you communicate solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

  • How you prioritize and break down work.
  • How you collaborate across disciplines.
  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose: We use references to understand patterns, strengths, and context to support you.

  • Provide 2–3 references who have worked closely with you.

Step 7: Offer

If selected, you’ll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation and other pertinent information. Our process is thorough and respectful, focusing on mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively and view this as a two-way exploration.

Join us and let’s build something extraordinary.

We partner with firms across financial services, MedTech, media, logistics technology, renewable energy, EdTech, e-commerce, and more. We are looking for a Platform Operations Engineer to work on a project in the data analytics sector.

The project :

Our teammates are talented people that come from a variety of backgrounds. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture based on trust and innovation.

We are seeking an energetic engineer with strong platform operations experience in AWS to join our client’s team in developing and scaling their data socialization and visualization platform, Atlas. This is a hands-on individual contributor (IC) role where you will lead by example through design, coding, and problem-solving. You will collaborate closely with their existing Backend Engineering Team Lead while holding primary accountability for platform operations. You will report directly to the CTO and work alongside the engineering and product teams to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance. While everyone contributes across boundaries on their small team, this role is intended to take leadership accountability for platform operations while also assisting with backend development.

What you will do

  • Lead the design, operation, and improvement of AWS platform infrastructure to ensure robustness, security, and scalability.
  • Manage and optimize CI / CD pipelines, observability, cost monitoring, and system reliability.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to develop and maintain APIs and backend services for the Atlas platform.

  • Participate in code reviews and peer programming.
  • Produce technical requirements documents and system designs for platform enhancements.
  • Collaborate with Frontend, Data Engineering, and Product teams to align platform and backend development with business needs.
  • Break down operational initiatives into actionable projects and lead their execution.
  • Mentor junior engineers and guide best practices in platform operations.
  • Provide on-call support rotation for platform stability.
  • Report directly to the CTO, providing updates on platform health, risks, and opportunities.

What you will bring

  • 3+ years of backend engineering experience (REST / GraphQL APIs, Python, or similar).
  • 2+ years of professional experience in platform operations, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps.
  • Real-world experience with SQL and cloud-based data systems.
  • Proficiency in AWS services (ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, Secrets Manager, etc.).
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise, with CloudFormation (primary) and Terraform (secondary).

Nice to have

What we offer

  • Ser responsável por configurar a infraestrutura de projetos escaláveis de aprendizado de máquina e modelos estatísticos;
  • Implementar pipelines de MLOps de acordo com as melhores práticas de mercado, garantindo versionamento e funcionalidade robusta da solução;

  • Colaborar com demais machine learning engineer com menos experiência;
  • Experiência com ferramentas e abordagens de MLOps como MLFlow, Spark, Git, entre outros;
  • Domínio de técnicas em conteinerização via Docker;
  • Habilidades de desenvolvimento de software. Diferencial se tiver experiência com arquiteturas de microserviços;
  • Experiência em processos de Devops, especialmente conceitos de CI/CD;
  • Superior completo em áreas correlatas a computação e/ou exatas;
  • Experiência comprovada de 4 anos na área de MLOPs;
  • Conhecimento de Cloud em AWS/Azure - Experiência com tecnologia de containers em cloud (AWS ECS/EKS, ECR, e/ou Azure AKS), Arquitetura Serverless (AWS Api Gateway, AWS Lambda e/ou Azure Functions);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Python;
  • Desejável: Experiência com o desenvolvimento e implementação de API’s (Flask, FastAPI);
  • Desejável: Inglês - Nível Intermediário;
  • Desejável: Mestrado ou pós-graduação em ciência da computação;
  • Capacidade de comunicação com stakeholders não técnicos;
  • Habilidade para traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas;
  • Conhecimento em Kubernetes;
  • Conhecimento em Terraform;
  • Avaliação: testes, dinâmicas e/ou cases

Nossa gestão sólida, aliada à inovação, nos posiciona como referência global no setor alimentício.

Na Minerva Foods, a tecnologia desempenha um papel estratégico na evolução dos nossos processos e na construção de soluções inovadoras. Investimos continuamente em transformação digital, segurança da informação e automação para garantir a eficiência operacional e impulsionar a sustentabilidade em toda a nossa cadeia produtiva.

Senior Software Engineer | Data Platform Team

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!

We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to our Data Platform team in Brazil (Remote) !

The Data Platform Team is responsible for building and maintaining system components that pave the way for data engineers and analysts to deliver their business objectives. This team leverages open-source software, uses cloud infrastructure and services, and builds software to accomplish its mission.

People on this team have different technical backgrounds, such as software engineering, systems administration (Kubernetes), cloud infrastructure and services, data analysis, and data governance.

This is an established team with a strong culture that expects collaboration, humbleness, accountability, empathy, and a sense of humor.

Some ongoing and future projects

  • Migrate existing data lake tables to Apache Iceberg
  • Autoscale Trino for data transformation pipelines
  • Creating a GitHub App to manage table schemas with data contracts (GitOps + DataOps)
  • Optimize data lake tables for existing queries with statistics collection and file rewrites

YOUR IMPACT

  • Advocate for improvements in software quality, security, and performance
  • Embrace the DataOps mindset to streamline and optimize repetitive tasks
  • Collaborate with Analytics Engineers and Data Analysts to drive efficiencies for their work
  • Provide tooling that improves the product development process and prevents failures
  • Ensure that knowledge is shared effectively with internal documentation and personal interaction
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • BS degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience
  • Solid experience with Python, Java, or similar
  • Solid understanding of relational databases fundamentals and solid SQL skills (PostgreSQL preferred)
  • Familiarity with Kafka, Pulsar, or RabbitMQ (Kafka preferred)
  • Proficiency with Terraform, Pulumi, or Crossplane (Kubernetes experience desired)
  • Experience with distributed systems and data-intensive applications
  • Knowledge of analytical data warehouses
  • Genuine interest in big data applications and their technology trends

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don\'t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We\'re a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

  • WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.
  • WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.
  • PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.
  • CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world. You\'ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of Life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Overview

O Ton é uma empresa do grupo Stone Co., focada em empoderar empreendedores autônomos por meio de soluções financeiras como maquininhas, conta digital, cartão e programa de renda extra. Nosso time é apaixonado por desafios e movido por impacto real na vida dos nossos clientes — sempre com leveza, autonomia e muita colaboração. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com um time de apaixonados por desafios, sempre preocupado em atender da melhor forma os nossos clientes e buscando as melhores escolhas técnicas para entregar os resultados. E mais importante, tudo isso em um ambiente descontraído com horário flexível e a possibilidade de trabalhar remoto.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

A equipe do programa Renda Extra | TON está dedicada a transformar vidas por meio de oportunidades únicas de geração de renda. Nosso programa oferece uma maneira inovadora para os nossos parceiros, de obter uma renda adicional ou até mesmo substituir sua fonte de renda principal sem nenhum vínculo empregatício. Nosso objetivo é empoderar as pessoas, proporcionando-lhes os meios para alcançar a estabilidade financeira e crescimento pessoal.

Senior Software Engineer Node

Você terá um papel essencial na evolução do nosso ecossistema, atuando no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, provas de conceito e melhorias contínuas nos nossos microsserviços e aplicações. Esperamos que você contribua ativamente desde a ideação até a entrega, participando de cerimônias, revisando código, mantendo e atualizando a documentação técnica. Fará parte de um time colaborativo, engajado em criar soluções escaláveis e de alto impacto, sempre em alinhamento com os padrões técnicos da companhia. Aqui, valorizamos opiniões, ideias novas e iniciativas — queremos que você protagonize melhorias e ajude a elevar a barra técnica do produto. Também é esperado que você compartilhe conhecimento com o time, lidere refatorações quando necessário, e participe ativamente do refinamento de demandas junto ao time de UX, garantindo entregas com qualidade e foco no cliente.

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência com NodeJS, TypeScript e Jest
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura moderna: SOLID, Clean Architecture, FaaS, APIs REST/WebSocket
  • Prática com AWS (Lambda, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, S3 etc.) e banco NoSQL (DynamoDB)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de cache e busca (Redis, OpenSearch/ElasticSearch)
  • Git, CI/CD, documentação técnica e segurança em desenvolvimento

O que aumenta as suas chances

  • Experiência Banco de Dados relacional
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de infraestrutura em código, como Terraform
  • Habilidade de otimização para suporte de alto volume de dados
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento como DataDog, CloudWatch e Splunk
  • Experiência com automação de Testes e testes de carga (Jest, K6, JMeter)

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta: com equipe médica 24/7
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação
  • Auxílio Remoto + Setup Inicial (para vagas remotas)
  • Horário flexível
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com livros, podcasts, treinamentos e videoaulas
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  1. Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve.
  2. Entrevistas com o time de People: papo para conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio proposto.
  3. Avaliação Técnica: aprofundar hard skills com possibility de dois papos ou um desafio.
  4. Check de Cultura: conversa com guardiões da cultura para alinhar crenças e visão.

Blue Orange is seeking to expand our Team of expert consultants with an experienced Machine Learning Engineer to address a set of expanding opportunities in the next several months. The ideal candidate will possess a deep passion for machine learning, AI tech and innovative data solutions with proficiency in advanced machine learning techniques, strong skills in programming languages such as Python, expertise around data analytics and feature engineering, experience working with some of the main ML and D frameworks, a proven track record of working with cloud-native solutions in at least 1 of the main clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure, or Snowflake, etc.), MLOps and LLMs, and strong proficiency in the end-to-end ML/AI cycle, from ideation to production. The candidate will have excellent communication skills to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.
At Blue Orange, you'll have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects, leveraging modern machine-learning and AI techniques to deliver tangible business outcomes and drive innovation in our data-driven solutions.

Note: Please submit your resume in English, as all application materials must be in English for review and consideration.

Build solutions that improve delivery speed and scalability of product pipelines.

Experiment with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches to improve the relevance and coherence of AI-generated outputs.

Stay up to date with the latest advancements in prompt engineering, RAG, data science, machine learning, and AI technologies, and explore innovative approaches to enhance Gen AI capabilities.

Experience with NLP and LLM-based technologies and frameworks.

Proven track record of successful delivery of software engineering projects.

Ability to think and learn on your feet and the ability to quickly become proficient with new technologies in a fast-paced environment.

Understanding and passion for Test Driven Design.

Familiarity with ETL concepts and best practices.

Excellent problem-solving skills, critical thinking abilities, and attention to detail.

Self-driven and autonomous.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Team player.

Eagerness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

5+ years of industry experience as a hands-on practitioner of software engineering and proven experience with cloud offerings.

3+ years of experience with cloud platforms such as AWS.

Experience with Docker preferred.

Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field.

Publications in relevant AI/ML communities and journals.

Experience fine-tuning OpenSource LLMs and deploying them.

Fully remote

title: Head of Sales - LATAM
description:
Who We Are

At MonetizeMore, we use AI and data to revolutionize how the advertising industry combats Invalid Traffic (IVT) and fraud. Our flagship product, Traffic Cop, is a premium solution designed to protect ad-monetized publishers and ad tech vendors from fraudulent activity. For over 15 years, our fully remote team of 100+ professionals has been driven by four core pillars: Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen. We are culture-centric, results-driven, and obsessed with building impactful, data-powered solutions.

What It’s Like Working Here

  • Actions > Talk: Execution is everything.
  • Slack & Async First: Clear, async communication is our lifeline.
  • Challenge Everything: “Why not?” is a welcome mindset.
  • Data > Ego: Bring your bold ideas—and the numbers to back them up.
  • No Titles, Just Results: Respect is earned, not granted.
  • Fail Fast, Learn Faster: Mistakes are data. We improve from them.
  • Follow Through: We do what we say—big or small.

Your Role: Head of Sales

As our Head of Sales, you’ll be responsible for defining, leading, and executing MonetizeMore’s global sales strategy. This is a high-impact leadership role for a strategic, hands-on sales expert who can build and scale a revenue engine across international markets, with a focus on high-value enterprise clients in the ad-tech space.

What You’ll Do

  • Own & Lead the Sales Function: Drive the entire sales cycle from strategy to execution—from lead generation to contract close.
  • Set the Sales Vision: Define and execute MonetizeMore’s go-to-market strategy in collaboration with the Executive Team.
  • Drive Strategic Revenue: Target and close deals with Publishers, have existing relationships, and understand needs of DSPs, SSPs, GCPPs, MCMs, and exchanges to drive partner-led sales for Traffic Cop across LATAM.
  • Build & Scale the Sales Team: Hire, coach, and manage high-performing sales talent, building a metrics-driven sales org.
  • Act as a Player-Coach: Stay hands-on in high-stakes sales conversations and negotiations while coaching others to success.
  • Present & Educate: Deliver compelling product pitches and demos tailored to client challenges and verticals.
  • Refine the Value Proposition: Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen our messaging and positioning in a competitive market.
  • Optimize Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and hit aggressive growth targets.
  • Establish Strategic Partnerships: Identify and onboard channel partners to amplify our reach and strengthen joint go-to-market efforts.
  • Inform Product & GTM Strategy: Relay market intelligence and customer feedback to help shape our product roadmap and growth initiatives.
  • Sell with AI in Mind: Understand and articulate how Traffic Cop solves complex fraud and IVT issues in digital advertising—positioning its technological edge as a major differentiator in the market.

Who You Are

  • Proven Sales Leader: 7–10 years of experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or ad-tech sales, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership role.
  • AI Fluent: You understand the fundamentals of AI and machine learning as they apply to digital advertising, fraud detection, or cybersecurity. You’re able to translate technical concepts into clear business value for enterprise clients.
  • Ad-Tech Fluent: Deep understanding of the ad-tech ecosystem—including publishers, DSPs, SSPs, and exchanges.
  • Strategic & Analytical: You use data to inform decisions and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.
  • Exceptional Communicator: Clear, persuasive, and confident in high-level discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Global Operator: Experience working across multiple time zones and regions, especially LATAM.
  • Self-Motivated & Results-Oriented: You take initiative, thrive in ambiguity, and are relentless in pursuit of your goals.
  • Builder & Innovator: Comfortable in startup or scale-up environments with a mindset for continuous improvement.

Why Join Us

  • 100% remote with flexible work hour
  • Work with a highly driven, globally distributed team
  • Be part of a fast-growing company solving meaningful problems in the ad-tech industry
  • Opportunity to shape the sales function and leadership path in a mission-driven, data-powered company

title: Agente de operaciones _ GIG
description:
Resumen

Seleccione la frecuencia (en días) para recibir una alerta:

¡Cada vez estás más cerca de tocar el cielo!️

Queremos que hagas parte de este emocionante viaje en donde podrás crecer y desarrollarte junto a un equipo altamente capacitado y diverso que te acompañará a seguir venciendo obstáculos y alcanzar tu destino.

Agente de operaciones (Part time)

En este rol velarás por la correcta ejecución de los procedimientos operacionales durante la atención y salida de las aeronaves en plataforma, garantizando el seguimiento en tiempo real de las actividades de cargue, con el fin de garantizar la seguridad operativa y el cumplimiento de los estándares establecidos por la compañía.

Funciones específicas

  • Realizar el monitoreo en tiempo real de las posiciones de las aeronaves en plataforma durante las fases de llegada y salida.
  • Supervisar el cumplimiento de los procedimientos operacionales establecidos para el cargue de aeronaves.
  • Verificar que se lleve a cabo el briefing entre el equipo de carga y operaciones terrestres antes del inicio de las actividades.
  • Confirmar que la carga autorizada coincida plenamente con la que se presenta físicamente en plataforma.
  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de la secuencia operativa y los tiempos establecidos en el plan de atención en tierra (turnaround).
  • Detectar, documentar y reportar oportunamente cualquier desviación operacional, condición insegura o incumplimiento de procedimientos.
  • Registrar evidencia fotográfica o en video en caso de incidentes, desviaciones u otras situaciones relevantes.
  • Participar en los briefings operativos al inicio de cada turno, para conocer la programación de vuelos y condiciones específicas del día.
  • Brindar atención integral al pasajero en todos los puntos de contacto, garantizando un servicio de calidad, la gestión eficiente de incidencias (retrasos, cancelaciones, sobreventa), y la correcta ejecución de procesos comerciales y operativos en tierra.

Requisitos

  • Formación académica: Técnico/Tecnólogo/Profesional; deseables carreras enfocadas al sector aeronáutico, operaciones aeroportuarias, logística o afines.
  • Experiencia: Mínimo 1 año de experiencia en operaciones en plataforma o en áreas aeronáuticas.
  • Nivel de Español, Inglés y Portugués: B2

title: SUPERVIA - ESTÁGIO - ENGENHARIAS
description:
Overview

Somos a SuperVia e operamos o serviço de trens urbanos na Região Metropolitana (Rio de Janeiro, Duque de Caxias, Nova Iguaçu, Nilópolis, Mesquita, Queimados, São João de Meriti, Belford Roxo, Japeri, Magé, Paracambi e Guapimirim), através de uma malha ferroviária de 270 quilômetros dividida em cinco ramais, três extensões e 104 estações .

Nós não temos uma história, temos várias. Somos mais de dois mil funcionários trabalhando diariamente por um mesmo objetivo: atender cada vez melhor os quase 300 mil passageiros que transportamos atualmente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar na coleta de dados e informações sobre os acidentes e incidentes ferroviários;
  • Apoiar no tratamento estatístico da base de dados da segurança operacional;
  • Apoiar as demandas da coordenação na comissão de apuração das ocorrências.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Cursando Engenharias - a partir do 5° período;
  • Conhecimento do pacote office completo (Word, Excel, Power Point e Outlook);
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar de 09h às 16h;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Conhecimento em Programação em Python será um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

  • Bolsa Auxílio: R$ 1.450,00;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Auxílio Transporte;
  • Auxílio Refeição de R$46,00 / dia;
  • Seguro de Vida;

title: Sr. Product Manager, Accounting
description:
Job Description

Manage product planning and backlog prioritization based on business value.

Align product solutions and backlog with Pismo's strategy.

Support Pismo in providing solutions for financial accounting, considering different financial products, clients, and accounting models.

Responsible for the entire product lifecycle, from conception, design, development, testing, release, to operation.

Conceive, deliver, and prioritize the product roadmap to optimize value for clients (current and future) and Pismo.

Collaborate with multiple teams to ensure cross-squad demands are delivered properly and completely.

Support product presentations and provide expertise to address the best solutions for clients and markets within the product scope.

Work with the squad and internal teams to improve product design, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability.

Manage expectations and deadlines for bugs and service requests, and help the squad understand the accounting 'language' for systemic solutions.

This is a remote position. Remote work does not require duties to be performed near a Visa office, but occasional presence at a Visa office may be required with prior notice.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or at least 2 years with an Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD), or 8+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience as a product manager or similar role with tech products (3 to 5 years).
  • Deep knowledge of accounting concepts.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Specific knowledge of financial accounting for card transactions.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Basic knowledge of the payment cycle.

Visa is an EEO Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status. Visa also considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with EEOC guidelines and applicable laws.

1 Developing critical situations (operational, weather, equipment failure, leaks, fires personnel etc) are identified and logged for later analysis

3 External agencies as appropriate are alerted in good time.

  • Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures:

1 Sample and check that controlled discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits
2 Identify and halt unplanned discharges where possible, and reported immediately according to policy, procedure and regulation.
3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure

  • Emergency Response:

1 Show competence during drills and exercises.
2 Carry Out Emergency Response Role

description:
(2025) Talent Pool - XP Future | Rio de Janeiro

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar!

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura.

A Iqony Solutions do Brasil é uma subsidiária da Iqony Solutions GmbH, fornecedor conhecido internacionalmente pelos serviços especializados no setor energético, atuando em mais de 80 países em todo o mundo. Desde 2002, a Iqony Solutions do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, oferece seus serviços nas áreas de Engenharia, Consultoria e Operação & Manutenção para clientes na América do Sul em usinas de geração de energia. O grupo é proprietário de aproximadamente 7.6 GW de capacidade instalada, incluindo plantas Eólicas, Térmicas, Solar, entre outras. Ao lado do investidor, oferecemos as melhores soluções para Engenharia e Operação & Manutenção. Atualmente, a Iqony Solutions GmbH opera mais de 6 GW de terceiros e 7.6 GW de plantas próprias. A Iqony Solutions do Brasil também oferece serviços no setor de energias renováveis com contratos no Brasil que somam mais de 5 GW. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro.

A IQONY Solutions do Brasil Ltda, assume o compromisso de atuação baseando-se na valorização e respeito aos direitos humanos, rejeitando todas as formas de discriminação, e está comprometida em promover e valorizar a diversidade, inclusão e equidade de tratamento em todos os níveis e processos da organização, zelando por um ambiente saudável e equilibrado de trabalho. Nossos processos seletivos são abertos para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, orientação sexual, cor/raça, deficiências, religião, nacionalidade, naturalidade, idade ou quaisquer outras características pessoais.

Descrição

  • Operar sistemas de transmissão como linhas de média e alta tensão, subestações, transformadores e sistemas auxiliares;

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Sobre a Lemon: as mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. A Lemon existe para facilitar que empresas e pessoas impactem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de energia mais barata e limpa. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, oferecendo atendimento próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico. Somos apoiados por investidores globais em tecnologia e buscamos construir um time diverso com experiências e formações distintas para criar a nova era da energia limpa.

Sobre o time de tech: o time de Tecnologia da Lemon é o coração da nossa inovação e crescimento. Nossa tecnologia é criada e mantida por times multidisciplinares, responsáveis por desenvolver soluções escaláveis que impulsionam a nossa missão de revolucionar o setor de energia limpa. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde a criatividade e a excelência técnica são valorizadas. Usamos Google Cloud BigQuery como data warehouse e SQL para as transformações entre as camadas do nosso lakehouse, buscando governança e qualidade de dados alinhadas ao negócio. Estamos em constante evolução e esperamos que você contribua para isso também. Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe de ponta e contribuir para um futuro mais sustentável, a Lemon é o lugar certo para você.

O que você vai fazer

  • Ter a oportunidade de ajudar a transformar em unicórnio uma empresa com um dos maiores potenciais do mercado brasileiro;
  • Ajudar na remodelagem do ambiente analítico da empresa, sendo referência no uso de dados e traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas robustas;
  • Aumentar a confiabilidade dos insights baseados em dados com boas práticas de modelagem de dados em produtos de dados fundacionais e derivados;
  • Ser responsável pelas pipelines de transformação dos dados nas diferentes camadas do nosso ambiente analítico, garantindo a qualidade dos dados entregues;
  • Ser um dos pivôs no aculturamento da empresa em Governança, Qualidade e Confiabilidade de dados;
  • Apoiar e mentorar colegas em práticas de engenharia analítica, ajudando a elevar o nível técnico do time.

O perfil que buscamos

  • Profunda mentalidade de ownership, demonstrando forte responsabilidade pelo que constrói e mantém;
  • Comunicativo, responsivo e didático, com capacidade de traduzir construções técnicas em explicações tangíveis ao negócio;
  • Colaborativo e responsável, ajudando de forma proativa seus colegas sem prejudicar seus próprios compromissos;
  • Interessado pelo negócio e com vontade de entender suas regras, características e particularidades — queremos alguém que se envolva, entenda e questione;
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade para colaborar em um ambiente de constante dinamismo. Somos uma startup e tomadas de decisão rápidas e assertivas fazem parte da nossa essência.

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • SQL avançado (otimização, CTEs, window functions);
  • Fluência em metodologias de modelagem analítica de dados (Data Vault, Kimball, Star Schema etc.);
  • Conceitos como Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Lakehouse, Data Mesh;
  • Fundamentos de Data Quality e suas dimensões, frameworks e estratégias de implementação;
  • Noções de BigQuery (GCP) - experiência em boas práticas e performance;
  • Versionamento de código (Git) e boas práticas no uso de esteiras de produtização (CI/CD).

Será um diferencial se você já tiver conhecimentos em

  • Programação em Python;
  • Dataform ou dbt;
  • Experiência com pipelines de ingestão de APIs, webhooks e arquivos de diferentes formatos;
  • Experiência com tratamento de dados semiestruturados;
  • Experiência com orquestradores de dados (por exemplo, Airflow).

O que a gente oferece

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Materiais de escritório;
  • Coworking em todo o país;
  • Cartão Caju flexível (utilizável nas categorias alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, educação, saúde e cultura);
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de saúde mental e bem-estar (Zenklub);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Lemon Feriados (dias de folga adicionais próximos a feriados).

Diversidade e inclusão

Aqui na Lemon a diversidade é um compromisso ético. Somos engajados em nos tornar uma empresa cada vez mais diversa e, se você se sentir confortável, gostaríamos de saber na candidatura se se identifica/declara pertencente a algum grupo de diversidade. Encorajamos candidaturas de pessoas com diferentes histórias e vivências para um ambiente mais inclusivo.

O DOT Digital Group é pioneiro no mercado de Educação Corporativa Digital no Brasil. Já são mais de 28 anos sendo responsável pela transformação de muitos negócios que decidiram abraçar a Tecnologia e a Educação.

O que fazemos: desenvolvemos pessoas para impulsionar organizações. title: Commissioned Sales Representative - LATAM Region (Remote)
description:
About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

O Consultor Comercial do Nibo é responsável por vender uma plataforma SaaS abrangente, que oferece soluções inerentes à rotina financeira, contábil e fiscal de escritórios contábeis e seus clientes. Sobre nós

Somos uma startup recifense focada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais inovadoras que geram impacto real no setor público. Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe. Seu papel será liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento do nosso produto de gerenciamento de atendimento (Service Management), construído sobre nossa plataforma low-code. O desafio é guiar o time na criação de uma solução robusta e escalável, promovendo inovação e excelência técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir o alinhamento técnico entre times e especialistas, assegurando coesão arquitetural e boas práticas.
  • Avaliar e apoiar decisões técnicas em frontend (Vue.js), backend (Node.js, Express), banco de dados (MySQL) e cloud (GCP), em conjunto com especialistas de cada área.
  • Definir e documentar diretrizes arquiteturais, priorizando escalabilidade, eficiência e segurança.
  • Mentorar o time de desenvolvimento, incentivando boas práticas e a troca de conhecimento entre áreas.
  • Atuar como ponte entre desenvolvimento, produto e design, alinhando soluções técnicas aos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Planejar, delegar e acompanhar atividades, equilibrando prazos e qualidade.

Principais desafios

  • Evoluir nosso UI Builder: Participar da evolução do construtor de componentes e páginas, que permite criar telas e fluxos completos utilizando recursos do Vue.js por meio de interface, com alguns cliques e poucas linhas de código. Nosso objetivo é trazer a experiência de codar para o UI Builder, permitindo que até páginas mais complexas possam ser construídas nele.
  • Desenvolver nossa solução white label: Contribuir para a evolução do motor de criação de plataformas white label, que oferece funcionalidades nativas como autenticação, gerenciamento de usuários, permissões, construtor de formulários, CRUD de tabelas SQL via interface, CSM, entre outras. Tudo isso em um ambiente isolado para cada cliente, com possibilidade de customizações específicas.
  • Aprimorar nosso marketplace de páginas: Criar e expandir o marketplace que permite a publicação, instalação e gestão de páginas desenvolvidas em Vue, compartilháveis entre diferentes clientes do nosso ecossistema.
  • Expandir nossa biblioteca de componentes: Desenvolver componentes únicos e reutilizáveis, como formulários dinâmicos, calendários, gráficos Gantt, listas com integração nativa a APIs etc.
  • Desenvolver soluções de IA e Machine Learning: Criar fluxos com LLMs, integrando funções acionáveis em contextos específicos (como consultas em banco de dados). Implementar RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) por meio de vetorização de dados, buscas por similaridade e integração com LLM.
  • Automatizar com fluxos low-code/no-code: Implementar soluções usando ferramentas como N8N e ActivePieces, construindo fluxos e APIs completas via interface. Também criar novos nós reutilizáveis por toda a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Contribuir para o open source: Apoiar a abertura dos nossos produtos para a comunidade, fomentando colaboração global e ampliando o impacto das soluções.

Join to apply for the Senior Growth Content Marketer role at Ottomatik.io

Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for a Senior Growth Content Marketer!

Note To Applicants

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Growth Content Marketer with a creative spark and a proven ability to grow organic channels through compelling, multi-format content. This high-impact, hands-on role involves owning the full content lifecycle—from ideation and production to publishing and performance optimization—across written, video, visual, and educational formats.

This is a maker’s role, ideal for someone who thrives on both strategy and execution, and is deeply proficient with modern AI tools and content platforms. You’ll be a key player in our growth marketing efforts, directly contributing to our SEO, CRO, brand visibility, and lead generation objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organic Content Channel Growth: Own end-to-end content creation and publishing across blog, YouTube, LinkedIn, and more; continuously optimize content channels based on analytics and business priorities; repurpose and remix content across formats to increase reach and ROI.
  • Video Production: Script, record, edit, and publish original videos in both long-form and short-form formats; create social-ready clips from long-form content using tools like Descript, CapCut, or Premiere Pro; act as the face of the brand in videos, explainers, and live formats.
  • On-Camera & Event Hosting: Host or co-host podcasts, webinars, roundtables, and video interviews; plan and lead live events, from workshops to virtual summits.
  • Visual Content Creation: Design eye-catching visuals like infographics, thumbnails, carousels, and branded graphics; utilize AI tools (e.g., DALL·E, Midjourney) alongside Canva, Photoshop, or Figma for high-quality output.
  • SEO & Web Content: Write SEO-driven blog posts, landing pages, and conversion-focused copy; collaborate with SEO teams to align content structure, keyword usage, and internal linking; perform content audits and optimize pages for performance and clarity.
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Improve web content and blog performance via testing and data analysis; refine messaging, layout, and CTAs to drive conversions; analyze competitor content and iterate accordingly.
  • Content Repurposing: Break down long-form assets into emails, graphics, video clips, and social posts; leverage AI tools like ChatGPT to ideate, draft, and repackage content efficiently.
  • Educational & Messaging Content: Collaborate with leadership and sales teams to ensure consistent brand messaging; create course materials, sales enablement content, and thought leadership assets.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years in content marketing or content production with a portfolio of organic channel growth.
  • Native or near-native English writing and editing skills, with fluency in verbal communication.
  • Expertise in video creation (recording, editing, publishing) with a strong sense of design and color.
  • Strong on-camera presence and comfort hosting events or webinars.
  • Proficiency in AI tools (ChatGPT, DALL·E, Midjourney) and design/video platforms, using them to amplify content creation.
  • Ability to produce high-quality content independently across media types.
  • Deep understanding of SEO, CRO, and B2B buyer journeys.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines autonomously.

Culture Fit – Core Values

  • Proactive – takes initiative and drives projects forward.
  • Simplicity – communicates and executes with clarity.
  • Expedient – delivers high-quality results efficiently.
  • Growth-Oriented – eager to learn and continuously improve.
  • Encouraging – collaborates with positivity and support.
  • Expertise – demonstrates mastery in their craft.

Nice to Have

  • Podcast production or repurposing experience.
  • Background in educational or instructional content creation.
  • Familiarity with tools like Webflow, Figma, Notion, Ahrefs, or Hotjar.
  • Experience with performance analytics and dashboarding.
  • Knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem.

What Success Looks Like

  • You grow one or more organic content channels through your own creative execution.
  • You deliver a steady stream of engaging, multi-format content that drives traffic, engagement, and leads.
  • You independently produce and scale content initiatives with minimal oversight.
  • You become a core contributor to marketing priorities across SEO, CRO, messaging, and education.

Acronis is revolutionizing cyber protection—providing natively integrated, all-in-one solutions that monitor, control, and protect the data that businesses and lives depend on. We are looking for a Cloud Partner Success Manager to join our mission to create a #CyberFit future and protect all data, applications and systems across any environment.

As the Cloud Partner Success Manager, you will leverage your experience in Account Management with a strong focus on Data Protection and Cyber Security. You will manage a portfolio of service providers using Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud in Brazil. Your primary objectives will include driving Annual Recurrent Revenue growth through strategic account planning, fostering adoption of new services, ensuring partner retention, and delivering a best-in-class partner experience that distinguishes Acronis in the market.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Conduct territory analysis and planning for dedicated geographies to identify top potential partners, develop relationship with key decision makers on partner side and maintain a regularity/frequency of contact with every partner depending on priority
  • Align with Acronis Cloud Distributors for joint activities for channel enablement and drive quarter over quarter cloud revenue growth working through assigned partners
  • Train new and existing partners with existing and new products, support new partners on daily basis on business and technology development, and guide them through onboarding and enablement stage equipping with all needed knowledge, resources and tools
  • Perform account planning with all managed partners with level of certain details depending on partner’s engagement, loyalty and responsiveness
  • Motivate and enable partners to sell Acronis services to existing customer base of the partner, attract new customers to partner and help to retain existing customer to partner
  • Drive partner’s satisfaction and acting as a trusted advisor and single point of contact throughout the entire partner lifecycle
  • Drive successful upsell/cross sell initiatives with partner to increase new services attach rate
  • Engage and orchestrate all needed internal resources to help dedicated partners’ growth, including Presales and Technical support teams
  • Profile every managed partner on vendors and tools they sell/use putting all information into Partner Passport. Every CSP Passport should have not less than 80% fields filled out
  • Know partner’s lifecycle management and be able to lead a partner along it through a set of regular activities focused on educating, evangelizing, making committed
  • Key KPIs: Total Revenue from signed partners, churn rate (% of partners leaving the program), number of Acronis services sold through the partner

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5+ years of sales and marketing experience in the software industry (Inside Channel Sales and Channel development position within a software vendor)
  • Fluent English and Portuguese, both written and verbal
  • Proven experience in a cyber security company demonstrating a strong understanding of industry practices and protocols is required
  • In-depth channel and field sales experience with an understanding of the cloud market business model
  • Strong presentation, communication, and planning skills
  • Strong internal customer focus with desire to learn all aspects of the business
  • High level of discipline, attention to detail, and ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment while still maintaining a high-level of accuracy
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills
  • Outstanding organizational, problem solving, and multi-tasking skills
  • Collaborative, team-player with a commitment to succeed and never give up attitude
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work with minimal supervision

WHO WE ARE

Acronis is a global cyber protection company that provides natively integrated cybersecurity, data protection, and endpoint management for managed service providers (MSPs), small and medium businesses (SMBs), enterprise IT departments and home users. Our all-in-one solutions are highly efficient and designed to identify, prevent, detect, respond, remediate, and recover from modern cyberthreats with minimal downtime, ensuring data integrity and business continuity. We offer the most comprehensive security solution on the market for MSPs with our unique ability to meet the needs of diverse and distributed IT environments.

description:
Overview

When you think of InComm Payments, think of Innovative Payments Technology. We were founded over 30 years ago and continue to be a pioneer in the payment (FinTech) industry. Since our inception, we have grown to be a team of over 3,000 employees in 35 countries around the world. We own over 400 global technical patents and a network that includes over 525,000 points of retail distribution that points to our industry expertise.

We are significantly growing our Engineering and IT teams in Brazil and are focused on finding talent for various financial technology (Fintech) engineering, database, development, and testing teams.

InComm Payments is highly focused on our people and their growth, and we work hard to make a career at InComm Payments meaningful and rewarding. We value innovation, quality, passion, integrity and responsibility in all that we do, and we are looking for great people to join our team as we move forward towards a very bright future. We anticipate developing future leaders for our teams in Brazil!

Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses! All positions are CLT.

You can learn more about InComm Payments by visiting our Website or connecting with us on LinkedIn , YouTube , Twitter , Facebook , or Instagram .


About This Opportunity

Join our lean and dynamic NOC team as a NOC Technician, where you will play a key role in maintaining the operational excellence of our network. This position is ideal for someone with a basic understanding of networking concepts and a strong willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, 24/7/365 environment. As part of our team, you will be responsible for monitoring alerts, managing emails and tickets, and escalating issues to ensure continuous network performance.
Given the lean nature of our NOC, flexibility is crucial. While your primary schedule will be 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, you must be open to shift changes and occasional late-night deployments to support live monitoring of our network resources during those deployments.


Responsibilities
  • Monitor network alerts using tools such as Solar Winds, Thousand Eyes, Pingdom, or Splunk.
  • Respond to emails and manage tickets in ServiceNow ITSM.
  • Escalate issues to more experienced team members when necessary.
  • Participate in shift changes and late-night deployments as needed.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure continuous network operations and quick resolution of incidents.

Qualifications
  • 1–2 years of experience in a networking or IT support role.
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, VPN, routing).
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools and ticket management systems (ServiceNow experience is a plus).
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends as needed.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn.
  • Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration and knowledge sharing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experi- ence preferred.
  • CCNA or other entry-level networking certifications are a plus.
  • Experience with AVI and F5 load balancers.
  • Familiarity with Cisco and Palo Alto network devices.
  • Knowledge of Itential automation tools and Ansible.
  • Experience with network monitoring tools such as Solar Winds, Thousand Eyes, Pingdom, or Splunk.
